output.revised_prompt: Create isolated production title artwork for a premium mobile slot game. Render the exact text, verbatim and only once: “PEARL FORTUNE”. It must appear in one centered horizontal line, with exact spelling and a clear space between the two words. Use highly legible, thick custom uppercase casino display lettering designed to remain readable at mobile size. Letter faces are sculpted pearl-ivory, with refined champagne-gold beveled edges, subtle deep burgundy inner shadows contained entirely within the letters, delicate integrated pearl inlays, and a few restrained diamond-like glints attached to or embedded in the lettering. Luxurious, festive, wealthy, warm marquee highlights; soft rather than solemn. Wide centered composition with generous empty margin around the title. The title is the only subject: no plaque, no frame, no emblem, no logo, no detached ornaments, no extra text, no watermark. Background must be perfectly flat, perfectly uniform solid chroma magenta #FF00FF edge-to-edge, with no texture, gradient, vignette, noise, shadow, reflection, or lighting variation. Absolutely no magenta in the lettering. No cast shadow and no glow may touch or spill onto the background; all shading and highlights must remain confined inside the letter silhouettes. Avoid script, thin letters, candy styling, and black background.
